product: 初中英语题库（中考笔试真题格式原型·原创练习）
note: 题型：choice 单选 / cloze 完形 / reading 阅读 / vocab 词汇运用 / grammar 语法填空 / task 任务型阅读 / writing 书面表达；grade 7/8/9；book 7a~9；difficulty 1-3。组卷按 grade/type/book/unit/difficulty 过滤切片。

questions.stem: — ___ is that boy? — He is my cousin.
questions.analysis: 问人用 Who；问物用 What，问地点用 Where，问方式用 How。

questions.stem: This is ___ apple. ___ apple is red.
questions.analysis: apple 以元音音素开头，用 an；第二次提到用 the 特指。

questions.stem: There are two ___ on the desk.
questions.analysis: 以 x 结尾的名词复数加 -es，box→boxes。

questions.stem: I ___ a student. My friends ___ teachers.
questions.analysis: I 后用 am；复数 friends 后用 are。

questions.stem: You ___ smoke here. It's not allowed.
questions.analysis: 禁止做某事用 mustn't（千万别/不许）。

questions.stem: She plays ___ piano very well.
questions.analysis: 乐器前加 the：play the piano。

questions.stem: The book is ___ the desk ___ the floor.
questions.analysis: 书在桌上用 on，地板用 under 表示在桌子下方的地板上。

questions.stem: Tom often ___ to school by bike.
questions.analysis: 主语第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -es：go→goes。

questions.stem: — ___ do you go to bed? — At nine o'clock.
questions.analysis: 问时间用 When；答语是时间点。

questions.stem: This isn't my pen. It's ___.
questions.analysis: 名物代 yours = your pen，省略名词。

questions.title: My First Day at School
questions.passage: It was my first day at a new school. I was very (1)___. A girl came to me and said, 'Hi! I am Lily. (2)___ name is Lily.' She (3)___ me to the classroom. The teacher was (4)___ and kind. We had (5)___ classes in the morning. At noon we ate (6)___ in the dining hall. I made (7)___ new friends. After school I went (8)___ happily.

blanks.analysis: 第一次去新学校感到紧张最合理。
and kind 并列，选 nice 友善。
肯定句用 some 修饰可数复数 friends。
go home 回家，home 前无 to。

questions.title: Healthy Eating
questions.passage: Tom is a middle school student. He likes eating hamburgers and drinking cola. He seldom eats vegetables. One day he felt ill and went to see the doctor. The doctor said, 'You should eat more fruit and vegetables, and drink more water. Don't eat too much fast food.' Tom listened and now he is healthy.

questions.stem: What does Tom like eating?
Why did Tom see the doctor?
What did the doctor advise?

questions.title: Spring Festival
questions.passage: Spring Festival is the most important festival in China. Before it, people clean their houses and buy food. On New Year's Eve, families get together and have a big dinner. Children get red packets with money. They watch TV and let off fireworks. Everyone is happy.

questions.stem: When do families have a big dinner?
What do children get?
questions.analysis: 孩子得到红包 red packets。

questions.stem: How do people feel?
There are three ___ (tomato) on the table.
questions.analysis: 以 o 结尾表有生命物加 -es。

questions.stem: She ___ (study) English every day.
My father is a doctor. He works in a h___.
It's cold outside. Please put on your c___.
This book is ___ (interest) than that one.
questions.analysis: 多音节形容词比较级加 more。

questions.stem: He runs ___ (quick) than me.
questions.analysis: 副词 quick→quickly，比较级 more quickly。

questions.stem: We have lunch at 12:00 at n___.
My ___ (friend) and I play basketball.
questions.analysis: 与 I 并列用复数 friends。

questions.title: Grammar Fill-in
questions.passage: Look! The boy (1)___ (play) basketball. He (2)___ (like) sports very much. Yesterday he (3)___ (win) a game. Now he (4)___ (be) happy. His father (5)___ (watch) him.

blanks.analysis: Look! 提示现在进行时 is playing。
父亲第三人称单数 watches。

questions.title: My School Life
questions.passage: My name is Lucy. I am in Class 3, Grade 7. I have six classes a day. My favorite subject is English. I join the art club after school. I go to the library on Friday.

questions.stem: What class is Lucy in?
What is her favorite subject?
questions.analysis: 原文 favorite subject is English。

questions.stem: When does she go to the library?

questions.title: My Best Friend
questions.prompt: 请以 'My Best Friend' 为题写一篇不少于 60 词的英语短文，介绍你最好朋友的姓名、年龄、外貌、爱好及你们常做的事。
questions.sample: My best friend is Li Hua. He is 13 years old. He is tall and has short black hair. He likes playing basketball and reading. After school we often play basketball together. He is kind and helps me with English. I am happy to have such a good friend.

questions.stem: We ___ a picnic last Sunday.
This box is ___ than that one.
Hurry up, ___ you will be late.
questions.analysis: 祈使句 + or 表示否则。

questions.stem: — Must I finish it now? — No, you ___.
questions.analysis: Must 否定回答用 needn't（不必）。

questions.stem: English ___ in many countries.
questions.analysis: 一般现在被动 is spoken。

questions.stem: The boy ___ is standing there is my brother.
I ___ already ___ my homework.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时 have/has + done；I 用 have。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the station is?
questions.analysis: 宾语从句问地点用 where，语序用陈述句。

questions.stem: I will call you ___ I arrive.
questions.analysis: as soon as 一…就…，主将从现。

questions.stem: It's difficult ___ the problem.
questions.analysis: It's + adj. + to do 固定结构。

questions.title: A Good Deed
questions.passage: Yesterday I (1)___ the bus to school. An old woman (2)___ on the bus. She had no seat. I (3)___ my seat to her. She (4)___ me and said thanks. I felt (5)___. Helping others makes me (6)___. After that I (7)___ to help more people. It was a (8)___ day.

blanks.analysis: 过去时 got on 上车。
好人好事 a good day。

questions.title: Save the Earth
questions.passage: Our earth is in danger. People cut down too many trees and pollute rivers. We should plant more trees and save water. We can also ride bikes instead of driving cars. If we work together, the earth will be better.

questions.stem: What is in danger?
What should we do?
What can we do instead of driving?

questions.title: The Internet
questions.passage: The Internet is useful. We can study and shop online. But some students play games too much and forget homework. We should use the Internet in a right way. Parents and teachers should help students.

questions.stem: What can we do online?
What problem do some students have?
Who should help students?
This problem is ___ (easy) than that one.
They ___ (build) a library last year.
If you don't hurry, you'll m___ the bus.
You n___ to practice more to improve.
She ___ (live) here since 2010.
questions.analysis: since+过去时间用现在完成时 has lived。

questions.stem: The ___ (invent) of the phone changed the world.
He is a___ from Japan and can't speak Chinese well.
He drove ___ (careful) and arrived safely.
questions.analysis: 副词 carefully 修饰 drove。

questions.title: Grammar Fill-in
questions.passage: The bridge (1)___ (build) in 1990. It (2)___ (use) by many people every day. A new one (3)___ (build) next year. The road (4)___ (clean) now. Cars (5)___ (not allow) to park here.

blanks.analysis: 每天用，现在被动 is used。
next year 将来被动 will be built。
now 现在被动 is cleaned。
复数 cars 现在被动否定 are not allowed。

questions.title: Reading Habits
questions.passage: Jack reads for 30 minutes before sleep. He likes science books. He borrows books from the school library. He thinks reading makes him smart.

questions.stem: How long does Jack read before sleep?
What kind of books does he like?
Where does he borrow books?

questions.title: The Internet
questions.prompt: 请以 'The Internet' 为题写一篇不少于 80 词的短文，谈谈网络的优点、存在的问题以及你的建议。
questions.sample: The Internet is important in our life. We can study and shop online. However, some students play games too much and hurt their eyes. In my opinion, we should use the Internet wisely. Parents and teachers should guide us. If we use it well, it will help us a lot.

questions.stem: I don't know ___ he will come tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 是否来用 if 引导宾语从句。

questions.stem: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
— He likes music. — ___.
questions.analysis: So + 助动词 + 主语 表示前者情况也适用于后者。

questions.stem: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
questions.analysis: 与现在事实相反，be 用 were。

questions.stem: He made us ___ the room.
questions.analysis: make sb do sth 用动词原形。

questions.stem: By the time he came, we ___ the work.
questions.analysis: 过去的过去用过去完成时 had finished。

questions.stem: The ___ of the match made him sad.
___ it was raining, we went on working.
questions.analysis: 尽管下雨仍继续，用 Though 让步。

questions.stem: The book ___ be Lily's. Her name is on it.
questions.analysis: 有名字肯定推测用 must。

questions.stem: He is good ___ math but weak ___ English.
questions.analysis: be good at 擅长；weak in 在…弱。

questions.title: Never Give Up
questions.passage: Tom failed the exam. He felt (1)___ and wanted to give up. His teacher (2)___ him, 'Failure is the mother of success.' Tom (3)___ hard from then on. He asked teachers for (4)___. Finally he (5)___ the next exam. He learned that (6)___ is important. We should (7)___ our best and never (8)___ up.

blanks.analysis: never give up 永不放弃。

questions.title: AI in Our Life
questions.passage: AI is changing our life. It helps doctors find illness early. Self-driving cars may reduce accidents. But AI also brings problems, like job loss. We should learn to use AI well and make rules for it.

questions.stem: How does AI help doctors?
What problem may AI bring?
What should we do?
options: Use it well and make rules

questions.title: Plastic Pollution
questions.passage: Plastic pollution is serious. Millions of plastic bottles go into the sea each day. Animals eat them by mistake. We should use reusable bags and bottles. Small actions can make a big difference.

questions.stem: Where do plastic bottles go?
Why are animals in danger?
What should we use?
His ___ (suggest) is very useful.
This problem is the ___ (difficult) of the three.
questions.analysis: 三者及以上用最高级 most difficult。

questions.stem: The government should take a___ to protect the environment.
We should r___ the old things instead of throwing them.
The letter ___ (write) by him yesterday.
He solved the problem ___ (success).
questions.analysis: 副词 successfully 修饰动词。

questions.stem: It's our d___ to protect nature.
We need more ___ (volunteer) for the event.

questions.title: Grammar Fill-in
questions.passage: If I (1)___ (be) a bird, I (2)___ (fly) high. He (3)___ (work) here since 2015. The letter (4)___ (write) by Mary. We (5)___ (tell) to keep quiet just now.

blanks.analysis: 与现在相反主句 would fly。
since 2015 现在完成时 has worked。
just now 过去被动 were told。

questions.title: Opinion Task
questions.passage: Some schools start classes at 8:30 a.m. Students say they can sleep more and study better. Teachers say it is good for health. Parents worry about traffic.

questions.stem: What time do some schools start?
Why do students like it?
questions.answer: They can sleep more and study better

questions.stem: What do parents worry about?

questions.title: How to Protect the Environment
questions.prompt: 请以 'How to Protect the Environment' 为题写一篇不少于 100 词的短文，提出至少三条环保建议并说明意义。
questions.sample: It is our duty to protect the environment. First, we should reduce plastic use and take reusable bags. Second, we must save water and electricity. Third, planting more trees can make the air cleaner. If everyone takes action, the earth will be more beautiful. Let's start from small things now.
